dispositions.topic_text: How opened-file modification time is carried to photo_delivery
Outcome when modification time cannot be converted to A7 datetime form
dispositions.reason: Every modification time the metadata reading can give converts: st_mtime_ns is a 64-bit integer, and its extremes give 1677-09-21 and 2262-04-11, both inside datetime; a conversion failure cannot occur.

dispositions.topic_text: Path-object binding when entries change between validation and opening
dispositions.what: Opening a named file component by component without following a link in any folder of its path, bound to the folders that were checked, so an entry replaced after the checks is never followed (as State 2 round-14 T20, round-29 T8 and State 5 round-01 T26).
